scope: Acceptance criteria, not an executable policy engine; not satisfied by local schema tests

cases.requirement: Server resolves the principal/role and exact scoped grant; body/simulated roles never elevate it.
cases.acceptance: forged request identity is rejected; an authenticated, scoped actor can perform its allowed action

cases.requirement: Declared authority level is not authenticated issuer trust; unknown provenance stays UNKNOWN.
cases.acceptance: enterprise text from an untrusted file does not grant higher authority

cases.requirement: Only trusted post-merge CI publishes canonical state after evidence verification.
cases.acceptance: schema-valid publisher=ci from an agent cannot publish

cases.requirement: UNKNOWN_ID rejects verification; NO_SKILL_MATCH is valid discovery; DISCOVERY_UNAVAILABLE halts the affected path.
cases.acceptance: all three outcomes remain distinct and permission denial cannot become direct execution

cases.requirement: SELECTED/LOADED/acknowledged do not imply execution or verification. HOST_SIGNAL also satisfies the stricter current-task execution requirement.
cases.acceptance: loaded-only, raw-ack-only and missing-current-task references cannot report execution success

cases.requirement: Consume task_criteria against actual nonempty outputs and valid execution evidence; reject unknown IDs and UNKNOWN execution.
cases.acceptance: empty/missing/wrong-content outputs, stale evidence and ignored criteria cannot PASS

cases.requirement: Qualification matches skill plus all four tuple keys; changed tuple is NOT_RUN and cannot select P0.
cases.acceptance: change each key separately, preserve historical records, reject partial match

cases.requirement: Qualification records cover every referenced skill and do not conflict for the same tuple.
cases.acceptance: a valid single record does not cover two distinct scope.skillIds

cases.requirement: Language changes rendering only; missing translations stay visible.
cases.acceptance: Arabic/English yield the same applicable set including all pages; unsupported language query is rejected

cases.requirement: repo-measured is linked to a successful candidate-bound eval, measured delta and authorized CP approval.
cases.acceptance: failed/unrelated eval and self-claimed measurement cannot calibrate or demote P0

cases.requirement: L1+ exports include PRIN-007, stay within UTF-8 byte budget and preserve every P0.
cases.acceptance: missing principle, overflow, stage=fail or lost P0 prevents every export mode

cases.requirement: compress requires explicit acknowledgement; compact additionally needs a version-bound governance-owner acknowledgement and qualified lookup.
cases.acceptance: body role injection, stale acknowledgement and missing lookup prevent export

cases.requirement: Proposal hashing uses the defined JCS artifact; a proposal change atomically invalidates bound checks, preview and approvals.
cases.acceptance: stale If-Match is rejected before mutation/export; invalidated decision timestamps/reasons survive

cases.requirement: submit changes validated to in_review only; approval/export/close honor the documented state transition and current proof.
cases.acceptance: cannot submit a failed draft, approve own role claim, export rejected content or close without trusted merge

cases.requirement: Advanced item paths, governance-owner review and skill adoption follow existing CP governance.
cases.acceptance: wrapper kinds never become governance item kinds; a lesson remains a proposal until approved

cases.requirement: Compare actual judgments for the same candidate/engine/input/config hashes; known divergence blocks accepted export and publication.
cases.acceptance: NOT_RUN CI evidence remains missing; a later unrelated pass cannot overwrite a mismatch

cases.requirement: Qualified platform adapter actually enforces wall time, memory and process-tree termination, retaining partial output.
cases.acceptance: timeout/memory overflow are explicit; absent adapter blocks; user cancellation is not measured overflow

cases.requirement: Seven honesty checks and eight skill scenarios are run distinctly from native host qualification.
cases.acceptance: unit success does not qualify Codex/Antigravity; unavailable observations remain NOT_RUN/NOT_OBSERVABLE

cases.requirement: Scanning, viewing and attaching evidence preserve canonical source bytes; state and evidence have no Studio write endpoint.
cases.acceptance: read-only demonstration has zero Studio filesystem writes, including logs and cache

cases.requirement: Projections preserve original grouped metrics/source YAML/raw stdout/stderr/output; absent measurements are null/NOT_RUN.
cases.acceptance: no fabricated zero metrics, no stale qualification reuse and no data loss during indexing

cases.requirement: Verify package signature, locked engine distribution and consumer CI provenance before accepted generation/publication.
cases.acceptance: Unsigned or unverified declared identity is not a verified installation; unavailable signing remains an explicit gap.
